result.instructions: Tools for Baseten, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of our model deployments are unhealthy right now?"; "Show the last 50 error log lines from the production deployment of our reranker model."; "How many replicas does each environment of our chat model run, and what instance type do they use?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Baseten data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run baseten_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run baseten_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run baseten_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. baseten_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: baseten_list_teams
tools.title: List teams
tools.description: List the teams in the Baseten workspace with ids, names and the default flag. Good first call: team ids scope the team-level tools. GET /v1/teams.

tools.name: baseten_get_team
tools.title: Get team
tools.description: Get one team by id: name, default flag and creation time. GET /v1/teams/{team_id}.

tools.name: baseten_list_regions
tools.title: List regions
tools.description: List the cloud regions available to the organization, where deployments can run. GET /v1/regions.

tools.name: baseten_list_instance_types
tools.title: List instance types
tools.description: List the instance types that deployments can use, as the Baseten API reports them. GET /v1/instance_types.

tools.name: baseten_list_instance_type_prices
tools.title: List instance type prices
tools.description: List the prices of each instance type, as the Baseten API reports them. Read only: no charge is made here. GET /v1/instance_type_prices.

tools.name: baseten_list_models
tools.title: List models
tools.description: List models in the workspace, or in one team when team_id is set, with their production and development deployment ids. GET /v1/models or /v1/teams/{team_id}/models.

team_id.description: Limit the list to this team.

tools.name: baseten_get_model
tools.title: Get model
tools.description: Get one model: name, team, instance type, deployment count and the production and development deployment ids. GET /v1/models/{model_id}.

tools.name: baseten_list_model_deployments
tools.title: List model deployments
tools.description: List the deployments of one model, with status, region, environment, instance type and active replica count. GET /v1/models/{model_id}/deployments.

tools.name: baseten_get_model_deployment
tools.title: Get model deployment
tools.description: Get one deployment: status, failure reason, autoscaling and backpressure settings, labels and region. Pass `production` or `development` as deployment_id for those. GET /v1/models/{model_id}/deployments/{deployment_id}.

deployment_id.description: Deployment id from baseten_list_model_deployments, or the literal `development` or `production`.

tools.name: baseten_get_deployment_logs
tools.title: Get deployment logs
tools.description: Read log lines of one deployment, filtered by time, level, replica, request id or text. At most 1000 lines per call (default 500). GET /v1/models/{model_id}/deployments/{deployment_id}/logs.

deployment_id.description: Deployment id from baseten_list_model_deployments, or the literal `development` or `production`.

replica.description: Only logs from this replica id.

request_id.description: Only logs for this request id.

search_pattern.description: Only log lines that contain this text.

tools.name: baseten_get_deployment_metrics
tools.title: Get deployment metrics
tools.description: Read metrics of one deployment: CURRENT values, a SUMMARY, or a time SERIES between two times. GET /v1/models/{model_id}/deployments/{deployment_id}/metrics.

deployment_id.description: Deployment id from baseten_list_model_deployments, or the literal `development` or `production`.

metrics.description: Metric names to include. Empty returns the API default set.

tools.name: baseten_list_deployment_replicas
tools.title: List deployment replicas
tools.description: List the replicas of one deployment with their status (starting, active, unhealthy, terminated). GET /v1/models/{model_id}/deployments/{deployment_id}/replicas.

deployment_id.description: Deployment id from baseten_list_model_deployments, or the literal `development` or `production`.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

tools.name: baseten_list_model_environments
tools.title: List model environments
tools.description: List the environments of one model, with the deployment promoted to each. GET /v1/models/{model_id}/environments.

tools.name: baseten_get_model_environment
tools.title: Get model environment
tools.description: Get one environment of a model: its current and candidate deployments, any promotion in progress, and autoscaling settings. GET /v1/models/{model_id}/environments/{env_name}.

tools.name: baseten_list_training_projects
tools.title: List training projects
tools.description: List training projects in the workspace. GET /v1/training_projects.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

tools.name: baseten_list_training_jobs
tools.title: List training jobs
tools.description: List the training jobs of one training project. GET /v1/training_projects/{training_project_id}/jobs.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

tools.name: baseten_get_training_job
tools.title: Get training job
tools.description: Get one training job with its training project. GET /v1/training_projects/{training_project_id}/jobs/{training_job_id}.

tools.name: baseten_list_secrets
tools.title: List secrets
tools.description: List the workspace secrets, metadata only (no plain text values). GET /v1/secrets.

tools.name: baseten_list_audit_logs
tools.title: List audit logs
tools.description: List workspace audit events, filtered by time, text or source (UI, API, MCP, SYSTEM, OTHER). GET /v1/audit_logs.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

search.description: Text to search in event details.
